SELECT r.name AS region_name, COUNT(*) AS delivered_shipment_count FROM shipments AS s JOIN customer_addresses AS ca ON ca.id = s.address_id JOIN regions AS r ON ca.region_id = r.id WHERE s.delivered_at >= '2027-04-21' AND s.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY delivered_shipment_count DESC LIMIT 200
